description: The tone of a filing or any text, sentence by sentence, from FinBERT run on this machine: an 8-K's press release by default, or a 10-K section. Needs the optional local models (canli-mcp models install). Tone, not truth, and no evidence it predicts a price; the model is licensed for non-commercial use.

section.description: For a 10-K or 10-Q: a section such as md&a.

text.description: Text to read. Or name a filing with company.
